author: Gundham
body:
Special thanks to KooDaLord for... erm... I used the towers you made in Dredmor as spawn structures in here, sorry for not asking first! <3
Credit will be given to you in the YML, as I did with Awarrior in Justice III :)

«§» Nexus: FFA - Scribblewood: Revamp «§»


Map Name: Scribblewood
Map Creators: MonsieurGray & KooDaLord
Gamemode: Nexus (FFA Testing)
General Information:
- Lots of different spawnpoints scattered around the whole scribbley map.
- Aesthetically more pleasing (includes less lag!)
- FFA = You're by YOURSELF. Everyone is your enemy!
- Generally, better than the old plain Scribblewood.
- Max Player Count: 40
